answer: Forging identities costs real capital, like felling timber from a shared orchard, so fake accounts lose more than they gain. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted beacon attestation: each agent must lock a bond and co-sign a periodic beacon round; peers verify signatures and slash bonds for duplicates. Honest participants earn yield proportional to uptime, making mass reputation slot creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
